title: Giraffe with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- neck -->
    <rect x='42' y='30' width='16' height='42' rx='7' fill='#F7C948'/>
    <!-- neck spots -->
    <circle cx='47' cy='37' r='3' fill='#C97A2B'/>
    <circle cx='53' cy='46' r='3.2' fill='#C97A2B'/>
    <circle cx='47' cy='55' r='3' fill='#C97A2B'/>
    <circle cx='53' cy='64' r='2.8' fill='#C97A2B'/>
    <!-- mane -->
    <rect x='40' y='30' width='4' height='40' rx='2' fill='#B35A1E'/>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx='48' cy='76' rx='24' ry='13' fill='#F7C948'/>
    <!-- body spots -->
    <circle cx='36' cy='74' r='3.5' fill='#C97A2B'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='80' r='3.5' fill='#C97A2B'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='73' r='3.5' fill='#C97A2B'/>
    <!-- legs -->
    <rect x='33' y='84' width='7' height='13' rx='3' fill='#F7C948'/>
    <rect x='44' y='84' width='7' height='13' rx='3' fill='#E8B33A'/>
    <rect x='56' y='84' width='7' height='13' rx='3' fill='#F7C948'/>
    <rect x='66' y='84' width='7' height='13' rx='3' fill='#E8B33A'/>
    <!-- hooves -->
    <rect x='33' y='93' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8A4A12'/>
    <rect x='44' y='93' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8A4A12'/>
    <rect x='56' y='93' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8A4A12'/>
    <rect x='66' y='93' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8A4A12'/>
    <!-- tail -->
    <rect x='71' y='70' width='3' height='14' rx='1.5' fill='#C97A2B'/>
    <circle cx='72.5' cy='85' r='3' fill='#B35A1E'/>
    <!-- head -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='26' rx='14' ry='11' fill='#F7C948'/>
    <!-- snout -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='32' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#F2B7A0'/>
    <!-- nostrils -->
    <circle cx='47' cy='32' r='1.4' fill='#B35A1E'/>
    <circle cx='53' cy='32' r='1.4' fill='#B35A1E'/>
    <!-- ears -->
    <ellipse cx='36' cy='18' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#F7C948' transform='rotate(-25 36 18)'/>
    <ellipse cx='64' cy='18' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#F7C948' transform='rotate(25 64 18)'/>
    <!-- ossicones (horns) -->
    <rect x='43' y='11' width='3' height='7' rx='1.5' fill='#C97A2B'/>
    <circle cx='44.5' cy='10.5' r='3' fill='#B35A1E'/>
    <rect x='54' y='11' width='3' height='7' rx='1.5' fill='#C97A2B'/>
    <circle cx='55.5' cy='10.5' r='3' fill='#B35A1E'/>
    <!-- sparkly eyes -->
    <circle cx='44' cy='24' r='4' fill='#2B1B4A'/>
    <circle cx='56' cy='24' r='4' fill='#2B1B4A'/>
    <circle cx='44' cy='24' r='2.2' fill='#5FD3F3'/>
    <circle cx='56' cy='24' r='2.2' fill='#5FD3F3'/>
    <circle cx='42.8' cy='22.4' r='1.3' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <circle cx='54.8' cy='22.4' r='1.3' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <circle cx='45.5' cy='25.8' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <circle cx='57.5' cy='25.8' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <!-- sparkle stars -->
    <path d='M41 16 l0.8 2 2 0.8 -2 0.8 -0.8 2 -0.8 -2 -2 -0.8 2 -0.8 z' fill='#FFF7B0'/>
    <path d='M60 15 l0.7 1.7 1.7 0.7 -1.7 0.7 -0.7 1.7 -0.7 -1.7 -1.7 -0.7 1.7 -0.7 z' fill='#FFF7B0'/>
    <path d='M50 14 l0.6 1.5 1.5 0.6 -1.5 0.6 -0.6 1.5 -0.6 -1.5 -1.5 -0.6 1.5 -0.6 z' fill='#FFF7B0'/>
  </g>
</svg>
